name: zclass_window_set_clear_polygon
description: zClass_Window::gwWindowSetClearPolygon validates the window node and sets or clears the high-bit enable flag on the clear-polygon index field.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass window/source-cluster pass because the adjacent window helpers share the same validation and flag-manipulation shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44fb40 validates the null node, null data, and wrong-class old error paths; sets the high bit of clearPolyIndexFlags only when enabled is exactly 1; clears the high bit for any other value; and returns 0 on success.

The native smoke verifies high-bit set and clear behavior while preserving the low clear-polygon index bits, plus null node, null data, and wrong-class return codes through the shared window helper validation path.
